findings.summary: Apple Speech consent is reachable but no production Speech adapter or usage-description metadata exists.
Packaged microphone and speech permission metadata is incomplete and live helper failures do not disable the affected source.
Capture can emit frames before Electron creates the source buffer, and live helper or source errors leave stale active state.
Capture lacks rolling segmentation and cannot cancel or reap in-flight transcription at Reset, error, shutdown, or crash boundaries.
The named gate does not authenticate the packaged local engine/model path and x64 runtime qualification remains pending.
Native timestamp provenance, partial transcript delivery, elapsed time, and preparing-answer state are not production-reachable.
The encrypted retain-finalized-transcript preference is persisted but not enforced by session recovery or archival persistence.

allowed: implement the explicit Apple Speech adapter and permission disclosure
make native start, error, crash, and source-state propagation race-safe
add bounded rolling segmentation and cancellation/reap-safe terminal cleanup
bind actual packaged local transcription evidence and represent unsupported x64 runtime honestly
make native timestamps, partial/final segments, elapsed time, and preparing-answer reachable
prohibited: a second general review or a second remediation cycle

deltaReview.scope: IC-M03-B01 through IC-M03-B07 plus regression of previously passing criteria

rollback: Revert the single remediation revision, terminate and reap every audio helper/transcriber, remove known ephemeral buffers, preserve encrypted session state, and restore both sources and Apple Speech to off without retaining raw audio.
